transcript.text: Hola, ¡soy Sparky! Estoy muy feliz de verte hoy. ¿Sabes qué? Tengo muchísima hambre y busco comidas divertidas para mi nave, ¡tengo una manzana roja aquí!
¡Hola Sparky! Me gusta la manzana red. ¿Sí?
¡Genial! A red apple is delicious, it is so crunchy! Do you like bananas too, or do you prefer strawberries?
Yellow bananas are super yummy and fun to eat! Do you like to eat your banana with some sweet honey on top?
¡Sí! yes. ¡Mmm! Me gusta la banana con miel.
Oh, honey and bananas are a perfect match! That sounds like a wonderful treat. Would you like to share a banana with me in my spaceship?
¡Sí! yes, me encantaría compartir la banana contigo.

That is wonderful, I am so happy to share my snack with a new friend! We had so much fun today talking about yummy apples and bananas. You did a great job today, and next time you can tell me all about your favorite breakfast, see you soon!
